description: 1 double bedroom, 1 single bedroom, 1 full bathroom, 1 WC, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Double-aspect apartment, windows on two facades. Kitchen at bottom-right of open plan space, wall counter, no kitchen island. Cook faces the wall, back to dining and seating. Living arrangement: split, seating bottom-left, dining bottom-center, kitchen bottom-right. Dining table visible, approximately 6 seats. No TV clearly visible. Bathroom config: 1 full bathroom; 1 WC-only room. Parallel morning routines possible. Large double bedroom (23.2sqm) at top-left. Single bedroom (16.5sqm) accessed from corridor. No en-suite. Single bedroom large enough for bunk bed. Possible configurations: (1) children's bedroom; (2) home office or hobby room; (3) guest room; (4) bunk bed. Storage room adjacent to kitchen zone, usable as kitchen pantry, laundry or general storage. Entry from right. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits couples needing a spare room, people working from home.
not_suitable_for: families with two or more children
